summary: Keep CSF checkpoint discovery and model tensor mapping in vLLM
compatibility: Requires the B12X CsfMatrix tensor-source loader API. Canonical CSF checkpoints and launch commands remain compatible.
details: vLLM validates manifests and model geometry, then passes lazy expert projection sources to B12X.
Shared shard handling preserves TP-bounded weight reads and closes files after loading or failure.
Retained tensors, FP32 calibration and native expert execution preserve their existing behavior.
